column11: derived: Pfizer generated $23,703mm of free cash flow on $185,759mm of revenue over 2023, 2024 and 2025, a 12.76% margin, against the 33.8% its cost of sales, SG&A and R&D leave. The 2021 and 2022 COVID years are excluded because a 36% margin on a vaccine windfall is not what this company earns. Restated before interest: PFE paid $8,181mm of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 4.40% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 22.18% to 17.77%. Checked at replacement capex: no plant depreciation on file for every year, and no amortisation line to take it out of the combined figure, so the charge stands. Restated without one-off cash: PFE's free cash flow over 2023 to 2025 carried $1,350mm of deal payments in operating cash flow, capital allocation whose assets the book values separately; $63mm of legal settlements; $4,400mm of US transition tax (2023 instalment 1,000mm; 2024 instalment 1,300mm; 2025 instalment 2,100mm). None recurs, so the charge falls from 17.77% to 14.52%. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 PFE's cash flow statement shows receivables up $25mm, inventories up $1,462mm, payables down $1,792mm, a working capital build of $3,279mm, 1.77% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 14.52% to 12.66%.

column12: the 0.25 is a judgement and the most arguable figure here. For more: a second BMP pathway mechanism for patients who stop or cannot take sotatercept, whose label carries haemoglobin and platelet monitoring (openFDA BLA761363); every 4 weeks against every 3; US orphan designation and Pfizer's specialty field force. Against: no efficacy result is published two months after primary completion; BMP9 signals through ALK1, whose loss causes hereditary haemorrhagic telangiectasia, so a vascular bleeding signal like sotatercept's epistaxis and telangiectasia (SOTERIA, above) is plausible; it would arrive seven years after Winrevair and after ralinepag, whose NDA is under FDA review (uthr_ralinepag.csv), and Winrevair's 2025 capture includes a first-launch backlog a follower will not have. pool_crowding shares the pool with ralinepag
